Aot Tag???
Swing around the city with ODM-style grappling gear

CONTROLS (PC)
Q / Left Click – Left hook
E / Right Click – Right hook
F – Both hooks
Space – Gas boost
WASD – Steer / orbit
Shift – Shift lock
Ctrl – Focus camera
V – First / third person

Mobile and Console Support are currently being worked on, so unavailable to the public

👍 Like & ⭐ Favourite to get notified about new modes and updates!
👥 Join the community for update news and giveaways!
